spans.text: I know the last few days have been really tough, and we did achieve some good results - we saved the Chairwoman, thwarted Paradeus, and recovered that...big metal ball...
...The ELIDs, duh! Those zombies are still wandering around in the city!
Also, just an hour ago, the local military has finished evacuating the civilians to safety, so now it's just us!
Thanks to the big mess from before, lots of ELIDs have been drawn this way, which can be a big problem for our own retreat...
Still, we've always had a knack for surviving, isn't that right?
It will be no different this time. We trust you, Commander. Please lead us all out of here and we can finally celebrate the end of this whole ordeal!
